description: This file defines the EvidenceService class and related components for managing evidence packages, including creation, retrieval, integrity checks, and linkage to approval records. It interacts with a database, handles filesystem storage, and incorporates hashing and audit logging.

classes.name: EvidenceError
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling evidence-related errors.

classes.name: EvidenceService
classes.description: Main service class providing methods to create, retrieve, and link evidence packages, with integrity verification and audit recording.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_evidence_package( self, submission_id: str, package_id: str, package_version: str, evidence_items: List[Dict[str, Any]], actor_user_id: str = "system", actor_role: str = "system", correlation_id: str = "", )
methods.description: Creates an evidence package, stores artifacts and manifest with hashing, and records an audit event.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_evidence_package(self, evidence_package_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves an evidence package by ID, verifying manifest integrity before returning details.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_evidence_artifact(self, artifact_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves an individual artifact by ID, verifying integrity through hash comparison.

methods.name: None link_evidence_to_approval( self, evidence_package_id: str, approval_record_id: str, actor_user_id: str, actor_role: str, correlation_id: str, )
methods.description: Links an evidence package to an approval record and records this linkage in the audit logs.
